results.rationale: CO-PROFILE explicitly lists PEC constructor registration category C-A/C-1 as not held, so the mandatory PEC registration requirement is not met.
The provided road construction capability records show contract values of PKR 142M, 199M, and 177M, which are far below the required PKR 700M each for three contracts.
We have multiple bridge engineering project records, but none state a span of 60m+ or confirm prime-contractor role, so the specific threshold cannot be evidenced from the summaries.
CO-PROFILE shows average annual turnover of PKR 900M over three audited years, which is below the required PKR 1,500M despite having 3 years of audited statements.
CO-PROFILE confirms ability to arrange bid security via CDR/bank guarantee and has a PKR 100M bank guarantee facility, which covers the required PKR 37M.
Road construction experience supports credible access commitments, but neither CO-PROFILE nor CAP summaries evidence ownership/assured access to batching/asphalt/crusher plants within 50 km.
CO-PROFILE lists ISO 14001 as not held, so the mandatory environmental management certification requirement is not satisfied.
Procedural commitment — complied with in the submission (construction methodology can be provided as part of the bid documents).
